text:
release-bot: Planned drift rollout for svc=router: v5.3.1 -> v5.4.0. Change window 03:30-04:30 UTC. Strategy: staggered steer (3% -> 20% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100%), 5m probe between steps, manual rollback only.
maya: Acknowledge. I'll monitor p99/p95, traces, and request error classes.
sam: Reminder to preserve cookie and TCP affinity for active sessions. If affinity changes, we need opt-in via runtime flag.
kevin: Command prepared: routerctl shift --svc router --from v5.3.1 --to v5.4.0 --steps 3,20,40,80,100 --pause 300 --preserve-affinity true --dry-run=false
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applied step 1 -> 3% to v5.4.0. Healthchecks OK. Telemetry: p95 125ms -> 135ms, error rate 0.08%.
tina: Fast heads up: 5 HTTP 504s on v5.4.0 from /internal/route in last 90s. Trace shows backend connection timeout.
maya: Hold at 3%. Do not advance until we confirm connection pool settings.
kevin: Investigating config diff. v5.4 default upstream_timeout lowered to 500ms. That could cause timeouts for slower backends. We'll bump canary to 2s locally.
infra-bot: infra-bot: config-push router.v5.4.0.upstream_timeout=2000ms --env prod --scope canary -> SUCCESS
tina: After bump, 504s reduced to 0 in last 5m. Error rate 0.03%. p95 back near baseline.
sam: Also discovered feature flag session-cookie-name changed in 5.4.0; it stays backward-compatible but older clients may drop cookies. We'll keep legacy cookie alias enabled during rollout.
maya: Toggle legacy alias on for canary.
infra-bot: infra-bot: featureflagcli set router.legacy_cookie_alias true --env prod --scope canary -> SUCCESS
kevin: Good. Proceed to 20% in 2 min. Add a longer hold (15m) at 80% to watch surge behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: advanced to 20% -> applied. CPU on new nodes +9%, latency stable.
maya: Noting p99 spikes from a small subset of traces at 20% but no errors. Will look for hotspots.
tina: Warming cache on v5.4 nodes: prober started with heavy cache-hit pattern.
sam: Heads up to client teams: expect some cache re-warms and a small increase in cold-start latency.
katie: I'll prep release notes: include upstream timeout tweak, legacy cookie alias, and advice for long-lived clients. Will publish after 100% stable.
kevin: If error_rate > 0.6% for 3m OR p95 > 400ms sustained, we rollback. Manual rollback command: routerctl rollback --svc router --to v5.3.1
maya: Agreed triggers. Also add alert on 5xx ratio increase > 3x baseline for 5 minutes.
release-bot: release-bot: Alert rules created and will notify #incidents and this channel.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: moved to 40% after probe. Metrics: error 0.05%, p95 140ms.
maya: Continue. If hotspots persist at 40% we may pause and collect traces for the specific upstream.
tina: Paused warming due to an ingress throttling log pattern. Investigating with infra.
infra-bot: infra-bot: increased ingress qps limit on router-v5.4-ingress-group -> SUCCESS
tina: After qps bump, ingress throttling cleared. No new 5xx.
kevin: Proceed to 80% per plan, start 15m hold timer.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applied 80% -> health good. p95 150ms, error 0.04%. Holding 15m.
maya: Holding and watching. Traces show a minor hotspot in auth-flow at p99, triaging with auth team.
sam: Auth team notified. They'll patch a retry behavior if load causes transient failures.
katie: Draft release note saved at docs/releases/4987654321-notes.md. Will update with auth patch notes if needed.
kevin: If auth patch is required and rollout delayed > 30m, we'll revert to v5.3.1 to avoid user impact. Standby for rollback.
maya: After 15m hold stable, proceed to 100%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: final shift to 100% -> applied. Telemetry stable: error 0.03%, p95 138ms.
maya: Marking rollout complete. Katie, please publish notes and tag release.
katie: Publishing release notes now and creating postmortem if any of the held issues persist.
release-bot: release-bot: Rollout complete. Remember to keep version pin for 30m for long-lived sessions and monitor the pinned metric dashboards.
maya: Thanks everyone. Closing thread in 1h after pins expire. Good job. :white_check_mark:
